name: Lud
title: Son of Shem and ancestor of a people
summary: Lud was one of Shem's five sons and a grandson of Noah. He is regarded as the ancestor of the Ludim, a people traditionally associated with Lydia in Asia Minor. Lud is mentioned in the Bible's genealogies as part of the group that spread out after the flood.

keyEvents.title: The Birth and Lineage of Lud
keyEvents.description: Lud is listed as one of Shem's five sons in the genealogy following the flood.

keyEvents.title: Descendants of Shem Repeated
keyEvents.description: Lud's place in Shem's lineage is confirmed in 1 Chronicles as part of the family tree of world history.

keyEvents.title: The Dispersion of the Nations
keyEvents.description: After the flood, Noah's descendants, including the line of Lud, spread across the earth and formed various ethnic groups and nations.

keyEvents.title: Lud Mentioned Among Distant Nations
keyEvents.description: The prophet Isaiah mentions Lud among distant nations to whom God will send survivors to proclaim His glory among the peoples.

keyEvents.title: Lud as a Warrior People in Ezekiel
keyEvents.description: The prophet Ezekiel mentions Lud (the Ludites) among peoples who served as mercenaries and warriors, along with other nations.

keyEvents.title: Lud in Ezekiel's Prophecy of Judgment
keyEvents.description: In the prophecy against Egypt, Lud is mentioned among the peoples who will fall by the sword together with Egypt's allies.
